description: Full public detail for one Partiful event by id: title, description, start/end time, location, image, host display names, and aggregate RSVP counts (going/interested/approved — counts only, never a guest list or contact info). Get the event_id from partiful_explore's results, or from a partiful.com/e/<id> URL.

event_id.description: Partiful event id, e.g. "4Epl0nZZS9krY6WJVB9X" (the path segment after partiful.com/e/).

name: partiful_event
